Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 120B, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Allegation against the petitioners is that they along with other co-accused persons took the money from the informant for depositing the same in various co-operative societies/companies of Sahara India Group but after the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57292 of 2023(4) dt.18-12-2023 completion of the period of maturity, the same has not been delivered to the customers by the directors and officers of the Sahara India Group.

entities.text: Awadhesh Mahto vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.

He submits that Rs. 5000/- crore has been released to the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies from Sahara SEBI Refund Account where the amount of Rs.
24,979.67 crores were lying unutilized.
The said amount of Rs. 5000/- crores has been directed to be paid to respective genuine depositors of the Sahara Group of Cooperative Societies.

He submits that the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies has taken steps to refund the amounts to the genuine depositors of various Societies of Sahara India and published a notice in the Gazette of India dated 20.06.2023 and in this regard a portal has also been made for refunding of the amount of genuine depositors.
5. Learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant opposing the prayer for bail submit that all the investor have applied through the portal but till date no payment has been made.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57292 of 2023(4)
dt.18-12-2023 case and the fact that investor has already applied through portal, let the above named petitioner in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Samastipur Muffasil P.S.
Case No. 526 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) devendra/-
